data.name: Dragonfly
data.detailed_description:
DRAGONFLY is a visceral first person shooter with destructible environments, lethal tactical combat, and reactive enemy AI that works together to cut your life short. As the newest member of Coyote Cargo Solutions Ltd, your job as a kinetic security consultant will have you dealing with the myriad of threats the post-war Viskran metropolis of Vis Vincennes has to offer.

These threats, ranging from bandits and criminal syndicates all the way to rival PMCs and national agencies, are brutal and unrelenting. You must rely on the Dragonfly armored combat omnirig and it's suite of battle abilities to end them before they end you. Turn yourself into a wrecking ball and smash through structures and enemies alike with the Assault module, or hear the panicked heartbeat of your enemies through walls with the Recon module. Upgrade and tweak your omnirig at the Armory for every mission.

No combat rig is complete without an arsenal of weapons. You'll come across weapons like the brutally crude Hummingbird 10-gauge shotgun and the sophisticated R&H SPIW-2 flechette rifle, which each one having it's own strengths and weaknesses.

Locational damage and an Armor system means that enemies will react differently to being hit in different areas. Shotguns and SMGs are effective against unarmored foes, but armored foes can be knocked down with repeated hits to the legs from even soft point ammo. Advanced threats will have protected torsos and arms- use heavy rifles or explosives to obliterate their armor and take them out.

Climb the ranks at Coyote and figure out the what happened in Vis Vincennes during the twenty year long rebuilding of the city from jagged rubble into gleaming marble, all thanks to the combined effort of the Hagenfield Association and the Viskran Reclamation Corps. Talk with your coworkers, take orders from the COO, and spend your well earned money wisely. Or not.
